news.text: Travelling to Shanghai, China for UbiComp/ISWC 2026!
Gave a talk about our vision of ubiquitous touch sensing at the NC State CPS-Robotics Seminar.
EpiPad accepted by ACM IMWUT / UbiComp 2026.
Received the Graduate Merit Award from North Carolina State University.
Received my Master en route at NC State.
Travelling to Los Angeles, CA for IEEE BSN 2026! The trip is kindly supported by the NC State GSA Travel Assistance Award and the IEEE BSN Student Travel Award.
Three papers accepted by IEEE BSN 2025: TouchWave, mV-IMU, and Hand-Grip Strength Estimation.
Started my Ph.D. in Computer Science at NC State, joining the SSCS Lab advised by Dr. Chenhan Xu.
Graduated from Tsinghua University! Really enjoyed my four years in Beijing.

experience.description: Developing sensing and learning methods for everyday computing and health applications.
Used sensor data to analyze workloads and improve task allocation.
Explored sensing and machine learning with everyday devices.
Developed sensing and communication methods for connected devices.
